title: ai-engineering machine envelope v1
description: The one object every verb prints on stdout under --json. Closed: a field that is not here cannot appear, and a reader written against this cannot be surprised by a field somebody added on a Thursday. The prose a person reads goes to stderr and is not described here.

command.description: The verb this envelope reports, as the dispatcher named it.

operation_id.description: One run, so two envelopes from two runs are never confused for one.

outcome.description: The terminal word. RUNNING is a phase and never reaches here.

changes.description: What this run altered. Empty is an answer, not an omission.

checks.description: What this run asserted, one fact per assertion, including the ones it could not answer.

remaining.description: What is still not done, in the words a person would use about it.

oneOf.description: Four fields and no fifth. A traceback is not one of them: it carries an absolute path, a username and the shape of somebody's filesystem onto a screen about to be pasted into an issue.

instant.description: UTC, milliseconds, and a Z. One spelling, so two envelopes sort.

x-envelope-policy.stream: stdout carries this object and nothing else; every word a person reads goes to stderr
x-envelope-policy.one_line: exactly one newline, so a shell that reads a line gets the whole thing
x-envelope-policy.no_escape_sequences: never decorated, whatever the terminal says it can do
